messages:
Maggie: quick sync — paid search + retarget for next Tue product launch. need audience cadence, frequency caps, budget ramp, and creative rotation windows. cc @Ravi @Sam
Ravi: got it. proposal: day 0-2 soft ramp to 20% daily cap, day 3-7 ramp to 70%, day 8+ at full. set freq cap 3/day for prospecting, 6/day for retargeting. thoughts?
Sam: like the ramp. one ask — inbound routing: put webinar signups into go/marketing-webhook, add utm_source=search & utm_campaign=launch_apr, mark lead_type=webinar so SDRs can triage.
Jen: creative plan: rotate 3 hero variants on a 24h cadence for first 72h, then promote best by CTR. also run 2-headline A/Bs per variant. retarget ads use social-proof snippets + urgency.
Leo: capacity note — APAC accounts have spend caps. if we hit 80% of reserved capacity auto-scale to shared-pool, otherwise fallback to lower-cost model. need infra to enable autoscale rule.
ads-bot: campaign-preview: prospecting_us | daily_budget: $3,000 | start: 2024-04-09 | creatives: 3 | freq_cap:3
Maggie: measurement: set a 10% incremental holdback on one geo (CA) for 14 days to measure incremental CAC. also want cohort bench vs last quarter.
Ravi: added a rule idea: if CPA > target * 1.25 for 48h, tighten audience (remove low-intent segments) + switch to top-performing creative only. will add to campaign sheet.
Sam: routing detail — webhook payload should include gclid + utm params. example payload: `{"gclid":"{{gclid}}","utm_source":"search","utm_campaign":"launch_apr","lead_type":"webinar"}`. frontend ok to append?
Jen: I'll upload creative drafts to Figma today: https://figma.com/file/XYZ-launch-ads. will drop timestamps for each variant.
Leo: pinging @infra to toggle shared-pool autoscale and confirm quota. @Maggie what's the ramp timezone?
Maggie: ramp starts 08:00 PT on launch day. product team tagged for final landing page QA.
Ravi: :thumbsup: will draft final config in the campaign sheet and post in #marketing by EOD.
Sam: coordinating with SDRs to expect webinar influx and routing rules.
Jen: once creatives are live we'll run a 48h CTR check and then shift cadence if needed.
Maggie: thanks team — next check-in at 10:30 PT tomorrow, otherwise post updates here.
